lawCoverage.requirement: One inherited envelope carries exactly one member of the closed five-plan union and forbids candidate, patch, batch, or nested-plan backdoors.
Every insert binds all six live QuickEntry snapshot fields and the canonical stable target before parsing or allocation.
A0 reparses the exact bound raw source exactly once through the injected public T0 fragment operation.
Complete-draft insertion requires T0 success, exact ordered warning acknowledgements, and complete materialized measures.
Recovered insertion requires T0 failure and applies exactly the one selected global ordinal with siblingsApplied zero.
Recovered insertion requires the fixed layout-loss token, resolved-or-caller duration agreement, and into-measure placement.
Complete drafts use one exact correlated placement shape for measure, section, or document boundaries.
Every newly inserted event uses the fixed balanced four-voice 48-84 generated policy.
Caller completion declarations are exact, bounded, and equal the materialized measure results.
Split duration retains the leading ID/content/annotation, clears trailing annotation, and preserves exact summed time.
Join duration requires immediate literal-equal neighbors with empty right annotation, retains left, and sums exact time.
Split section retains the leading section, allocates only the suffix, moves measures without changing their identities.
Join section compares both metadata snapshots, retains left, preserves measure order, and applies explicit result metadata.
Every operation preserves normalized exact timeline laws under deterministic collection bounds without wall-time cutoffs.
All non-ID laws precede honest-entropy allocation in fixed structural order; first failure or collision stops without retry.
Commit publishes one revision/history entry, exact bookmark and focus repair, four ordered effects, and no partial refusal state.
All five operations commute with spelling-preserving transposition while existing accepted A0 behavior remains unchanged.
